name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
description: PMGKAY is a food-security programme that provides free foodgrains to eligible ration-card holders covered under the National Food Security Act framework.
benefits: Official myScheme information states that Antyodaya Anna Yojana families receive 35 kg of foodgrains per family per month and Priority Household beneficiaries receive 5 kg per person per month, subject to current rules and identification. Foodgrains are provided free of cost under the programme.
eligibility: Eligibility is for Antyodaya Anna Yojana and Priority Household categories identified under the applicable food-security processes. State and Union Territory authorities determine card categories and final entitlement.
documents: Use a ration card and, where applicable, the identity or authentication requirements specified by the local fair-price shop and State or Union Territory authority.
application_process: Eligible beneficiaries collect their entitlement at a fair-price shop. Check ration-card status and local procedures with the responsible food-distribution authority.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) cardholders
